sections.title: Mandatory Focus with Restrictive Particles
sections.content: The particles 'csak' (only), 'éppen' (precisely / just), and 'kizárólag' (exclusively / solely) inherently bind to the constituent they modify and pull it into the pre-verbal focus slot. Consequently, whenever a 'csak/éppen/kizárólag + phrase' precedes a prefixed verb, the preverb MUST split and move behind the verb.

sections.title: Nuance Differences: csak vs. éppen vs. kizárólag
sections.content: 'Csak' sets a quantitative or temporal limit ('Csak ekkor döbbent rá' — Only then did he realize). 'Éppen' highlights ironic coincidence or pinpoint precision ('Éppen a legfontosabb szót hallgatta el' — It was precisely the most important word that he suppressed). 'Kizárólag' belongs to a more deliberate, emphatic register ('Kizárólag a lányuk kedvéért mondtak le mindenről' — Solely for their daughter's sake did they give up everything).

sections.title: Exclusivity Particles and Inversion
rows: She went away for only one week.
Csak ekkor döbbent rá az igazságra.
Only then did he realize the truth.
It was precisely the main point that they kept silent.
Kizárólag érte mondtak le az örömökről.
Solely for her sake did they give up pleasures.

items.spanish: Csak egyetlen hétre utazott el a lány, mégis minden megváltozott.
items.english: The girl went away for only a single week, yet everything changed.

items.spanish: Éppen a legnehezebb kérdést kerülték ki egész este.
items.english: It was precisely the hardest question that they avoided all evening.

items.spanish: Kizárólag Pacsirta miatt mondtak le korábban a színházról.
items.english: It was exclusively because of Pacsirta that they had previously given up the theatre.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Never leave the preverb attached to the verb when a 'csak X', 'éppen X', or 'kizárólag X' phrase immediately precedes it: say 'Csak ekkor vette észre', never '*Csak ekkor észrevette'.
